bugs.title: B-16df's registered validate-command-timeout-smoke section 12 asserts validation-executor.ts and verifier.ts are byte-for-byte identical to main, which deterministically fails validate for EVERY story that edits either file. Confirmed: node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-command-timeout-smoke.js exits 1 with FAIL: validation-executor.ts and verifier.ts are byte-for-byte unmodified from main (empty git diff). Registered at validate.commands[10]. The assertion reads as B-16df's own scope self-check (its fix was confined to checklist.ts), but as a standing gate it has no meaning on main (trivially true there) and forbids all future edits to two actively-developed core files. B-3434 changes both by 808 insertions as its entire purpose. First surfaced by the cross-vendor host-B reviewer at packages/main/src/tasks/validate-command-timeout-smoke.ts:383-394 and reproduced independently.

evidence.symptom: Every story that edits packages/main/src/core/validation-executor.ts or packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts fails lattice validate at validate.commands[10] with 'FAIL: validation-executor.ts and verifier.ts are byte-for-byte unmodified from main (empty git diff)'. The failure is deterministic and unrelated to the editing story's own correctness.
reproSteps: Check out any branch that modifies packages/main/src/core/validation-executor.ts or packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts relative to main.
Observe exit 1 with the byte-for-byte FAIL, while every other assertion in the file passes.
evidence.hypothesis: Section 12 of B-16df's validate-command-timeout-smoke was written as that story's own scope self-check (B-16df's fix was confined to checklist.ts), then registered into lattice.config.json validate.commands as a standing gate. As a standing gate it is trivially true on main and unsatisfiable off it, so it does not test a property of the system - it tests that nobody edits two actively-developed core files.
evidence.rootCause: A per-story scope self-check was promoted to a repository-wide standing gate. The assertion ran git diff main -- <two paths> and demanded the output be empty. On main the diff is always empty, so the gate never fires there and never bought anything; on any story branch touching either file the diff is never empty, so the gate always fires regardless of whether the change is correct. B-3434 modifies both files by 808 insertions as its entire purpose, which is what surfaced it.
evidence.fixEvidence: The unsatisfiable assertion and its execSync import were removed in efe682df11, and its docblock claims were corrected in 17dc863c05. Removal alone would have been a net loss of coverage, so the same commits replaced it with something that actually tests a property: new section 17 pins the exact membership of VERIFICATION_COMMAND_EXECUTABLE_ALLOWLIST (packages/main/src/core/validation-executor.ts:1215-1223), read from the real constant rather than restated, and asserts parseAllowlistedCommand rejects a non-member leading token. This matters because the quality lane measured that the allowlist had ZERO assertions anywhere in the repository: adding 'bash' to it - a security-relevant widening that would let a pinned verification-evidence command run an arbitrary shell - left the smoke green at 44/44, exit 0. The byte-pin had been covering that constant only ACCIDENTALLY, by failing on any diff at all. Both halves of section 17 were shown to fail INDEPENDENTLY in disposable mirrors: widening the allowlist alone fails 17a, widening it and the expected literal together fails 17b, and a control that widened the allowlist while stripping section 17 reproduced the pre-change green state. Assertion count 45 -> 44 -> 46, positions 1-45 identical in order. HONEST RESIDUAL: section 17 replaces only a SLICE of what the byte-pin incidentally covered - the byte-pin failed on any byte of either file changing, including untested symbols, while section 17 covers one constant's membership and one rejection path. What it gained is discrimination and durability: it fires on a semantically meaningful widening, stays silent on a rename, holds on main as well as off it, and names the token that moved.
evidence.reproTest: packages/main/src/tasks/validate-command-timeout-smoke.ts (sections 17a/17b; built to packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-command-timeout-smoke.js and registered at lattice.config.json validate.commands)
